subject: Hospitality
title: The Rooftop Bar Phenomenon
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Rooftop Bar Phenomenon.

hook.text: Rooftop bars generate up to 50% more revenue per seat than ground-level bars. The view justifies higher prices automatically.

buildup.text: Cities like Bangkok, New York, and Dubai have iconic rooftop bars that attract tourists specifically. The bar IS the destination.

discovery.text: Rooftop design challenges include wind, weather, weight limits, and noise regulations from neighbors.

twist.text: Many rooftop bars are more profitable than the hotel rooms below them. A $20 cocktail with a view beats a discounted room rate.

climax.text: The rooftop trend forced architects to rethink what was traditionally dead utility space. Mechanical rooms moved; revenue moved.

punchline.text: Same drink, add a view, charge double. Rooftops turned wasted space into gold.
